newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to bring home illegal workers from Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to bring home illegal workers from Malaysia.

text.p: Indonesia said on Thursday it was planning to bring home thousands of illegal workers from Malaysia using navy ships.

"The president has asked me to discuss the matter with the armed forces and navy chiefs to bring them home using navy ships," Manpower Minister Abdul Latief told reporters after meeting with President Suharto.
Latief said he had visited about 5,000 illegal Indonesian workers being detained in camps by the Malaysian government.

"Some of them will be allowed to return to work there if Malaysian businesmen want to employ them. But the rest, who have no expertise, are illiterate, too young or sick will be brought home," Latief said.
Latief gave no further details on when the repatriation might take place.
He said there were about 1.5 million Indonesia workers in Malaysia but the exact number of illegal workers was unknown.
